usedFor: Play AI holds AI agents, where “Create Agent” sets one up and “Create PlayNote” uses a file URL.

bestTemplate.name: “Record Created Or Updated” in Airtable, then “Create PlayNote” in Play AI
bestTemplate.why: A changed record becomes a PlayNote built from a file URL.

watchOut: “Update Agent” and “Update External Function” need the ID of the item you change.
